payload.reason: The evidence discusses the lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in synthetic well logs despite their preservation at certain locations, indicating a preservation bias and the influence of sedimentation and erosion processes.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are preserved at Lembetabe, but corresponding sequences in synthetic well logs are sometimes lacking due to preservation bias.
The presence of modern active dune fields and fossilized aeolianites covering MIS 5e reefs suggests limited exposure time for previously deposited limestone.
